# Provider capability reference

See [SPEC §10](../SPEC.md) and [ADR-0102](../adr/0102-every-provider-declares-what-it-can-do-and-chorusd-refuses-a-pipeline-that-cannot-work.md). `chorusd` checks the providers it is configured with against these same declarations at startup: a required need a provider lacks stops it, and a degraded one is logged with what it costs.

## What each role needs

| Role | Capability | Lacking it | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| stt | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |
| stt | `languages` | **refused**: speech in any other language is transcribed as if it were one the ear knows, so every turn answers words nobody said; CHORUS_STT_PROVIDER=wyoming or openai with a Whisper hears others | SPEC §10 |
| endpointing | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |
| speaker_id | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |
| embedding | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |
| llm | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |
| llm | `streams_text` | degraded: nothing is said until the model has written its whole reply, so every answer waits out its slowest sentence | SPEC §11 |
| llm | `streams_tool_arguments` | degraded: a speak call's words reach the voice only once the call closes, so first audio waits for the model to write the whole call; CHORUS_LLM_PROVIDER=vllm streams them | SPEC §4.1, SPEC §11, ADR-0077 |
| llm | `tool_calls` | **refused**: speak is a tool, so the model could say nothing and act on nothing | SPEC §4.1, ADR-0003 |
| tts | `cancels` | **refused**: a barge-in or a deadline cannot stop it, so the turn waits on work nobody is waiting for | SPEC §4.3 |

## stt

| Provider | `cancels` | `languages` |
|---|---|---|
| `openai` | yes | its model's |
| `speaches` | yes | en |
| `wyoming` | yes | its model's |

- `openai`: Any server with OpenAI's /v1/audio/transcriptions (ADR-0081). It hears what its model hears.
- `speaches`: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 behind speaches' /v1/audio/transcriptions, the default ear (ADR-0024). English only: it accepts a language and ignores it.
- `wyoming`: A Wyoming ASR server over TCP, such as Home Assistant's whisper (ADR-0081). It hears what its model hears.

## endpointing

| Provider | `cancels` |
|---|---|
| `smartturn` | yes |

- `smartturn`: Smart Turn v3.2, the sidecar in sidecars/smartturn (ADR-0036).

## speaker_id

| Provider | `cancels` |
|---|---|
| `speakerid` | yes |

- `speakerid`: TitaNet-L on ONNX Runtime, the sidecar in sidecars/speakerid (ADR-0029).

## embedding

| Provider | `cancels` |
|---|---|
| `ollama` | yes |

- `ollama`: An embedding model on Ollama's /api/embed, for memory recall by relevance (ADR-0044).

## llm

| Provider | `cancels` | `streams_text` | `streams_tool_arguments` | `tool_calls` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ollama` | yes | yes | no | yes |
| `vllm` | yes | yes | yes | yes |

- `ollama`: Qwen3 on Ollama's /api/chat, the default turn engine (ADR-0037). A tool call arrives whole, as a native JSON object.
- `vllm`: Qwen3 on vLLM's /v1/chat/completions (ADR-0077). A call dispatches when its arguments close, and a speak call's words stream out of them as they arrive.

## tts

| Provider | `cancels` |
|---|---|
| `kokoro` | yes |
| `openai` | yes |
| `wyoming` | yes |

- `kokoro`: Kokoro-82M behind Kokoro-FastAPI, the default voice, rendered at 24 kHz and resampled by the host (ADR-0023).
- `openai`: Any server with OpenAI's /v1/audio/speech, asked for WAV (ADR-0081).
- `wyoming`: A Wyoming TTS server over TCP, such as Home Assistant's piper (ADR-0081).
